



                        ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
                        │                                                  │
                        │  Keybindings                                     │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Navigation                                    │
                        │    j/k ↑/↓       Navigate rows (items & tasks)   │
                        │    J/K            Jump to next/prev item (skip   │
                        │  tasks)                                          │
                        │    g/G            Jump to top/bottom             │
                        │    Ctrl+d/u       Half-page down/up              │
                        │    h/l ←/→       Switch panes                    │
                        │    Tab            Toggle pane focus              │
                        │    Enter          Read the item or project       │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    In the reader                                 │
                        │    j/k  Ctrl+d/u  Scroll by line / half page     │
                        │    g/G            Top/bottom                     │
                        │    Esc  q  h      Back to where it was opened    │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Project Pane                                  │
                        │    a              Add project                    │
                        │    m              Move/reorder project           │
                        │    C              Show/hide shelved and closed   │
                        │  projects                                        │
                        │    space          Toggle multi-select            │
                        │    Esc            Clear selections               │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Reading a project                             │
                        │    e              Edit name                      │
                        │    d              Edit description in $EDITOR    │
                        │    c              Complete project               │
                        │    x              Drop project (asks why)        │
                        │    S              Shelve project for someday     │
                        │    r              Reopen a shelved or closed     │
                        │  project                                         │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    Global                                        │
                        │    u              Undo last action               │
                        │    /              Search                         │
                        │    1              Filter: blocked only (toggle)  │
                        │    2              Filter: all + archived         │
                        │  (toggle)                                        │
                        │    0              Filter: reset                  │
                        │    R              Sync now (runs automatically   │
                        │  too)                                            │
                        │    q  Ctrl+C      Quit                           │
                        │    ?              Toggle this help               │
                        │                                                  │
                        │    [Esc] or [?] Close                            │
                        │                                                  │
                        ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
